summary: The workflowcheck static analyzer needs multiple improvements including environment/system property configuration support, lambda analysis, module support, field mutation prevention, config prebuilding with stdlib presets, SARIF output, and enhanced result formatting with deep tree abbreviation.
userImpact: Users need better configuration options, more comprehensive static analysis coverage, and improved integration with development tools and IDEs.
proposedFix: Add support for environment variables and Java system properties for config, implement lambda content checking, add module support, prevent field mutations in queries/validators, create config prebuilding with stdlib presets, add SARIF output format, improve IntelliJ console linking, provide HTML-formatted results with collapsible hierarchy, and support tree abbreviation for deep nesting.
keyQuote: the `workflowcheck` static analyzer done in #2767 could use the following improvements
